motion.name: reduced-motion

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Submit an action. ActionForm uses the disabled state and Saving... label while pending. Source: src/app/_components/action-form.tsx and src/app/globals.css.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #292723); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent, #292723); color: var(--accent-ink, #fffefa); font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.6; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #48463e; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #74633c); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.6; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none !important; } }

components.name: Primary navigation
components.description: Horizontal route links within the pale header. The current route has an ink underline. Source: src/app/_components/navigation.tsx.

components.css: .ds-header { padding: 17px 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--panel, #f4f3ed); } .ds-primary-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 30px; color: var(--ink, #292723); font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-primary-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; white-space: nowrap; color: inherit; font-size: 13px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-primary-link[aria-current="page"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; bottom: -17px; width: 100%; height: 2px; background: var(--ink, #292723); } .ds-primary-link:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--muted, #68665e); } .ds-primary-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #74633c); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 1180px) { .ds-header { padding: 15px 20px; } .ds-primary-nav { gap: 20px; } .ds-primary-link[aria-current="page"]::after { bottom: -15px; } } @media (max-width: 960px) { .ds-primary-nav { width: 100%; justify-content: center; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #dfddd4); padding-top: 10px; } } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-header { padding: 17px 20px 12px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-primary-nav { justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding-top: 7px; } .ds-primary-link { font-size: 11px; min-height: 36px; } .ds-primary-link[aria-current="page"]::after { bottom: -12px; } }

narrative.overview:
Atrium places the staff Meetup application inside a warm stone frame. Ivory paper, charcoal controls and untinted Activity photographs give discovery, personal pages and administration one visual identity.

The user selected Atrium from the interactive prototypes. This document records the production implementation in [globals.css](src/app/globals.css) and [layout.tsx](src/app/layout.tsx). [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) records the selection; [the implementation record](docs/atrium-ui.md) links its preview evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone surrounds ivory paper and pale panels.
Manrope carries headings, body text and controls.
Horizontal navigation and compact tables carry the administrative workflows.

rules.name: Shared palette
rules.body: Use the same ground, paper, panel and ink tokens across Member and administrative pages.

rules.name: Manrope
rules.body: Use Manrope for headings, body text and controls, with tabular numerals for dates and counts.

rules.name: Flat panels
rules.body: Use tone, whitespace and thin dividers to separate content; panels have no shadows.

dos: Do reuse the shared shell and palette for Member, Organisation Admin and Platform Admin pages.
Do keep Activity, time, Place and participation facts readable beside illustrative photography.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, pending feedback and labeled horizontal table scrolling.
Do use the existing Manrope hierarchy, modest corners and flat panels.
donts: Don't mix the Studio or Fieldwork prototype styles into Atrium.
Don't tint Activity photographs or present stock images as actual Sites, Hosts or Participants.
Don't shrink mobile report text to fit every column; retain the scroll region.
Don't add shadows to the flat panel system.
